title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS REFLECT THE IDEOLOGY OF THEIR CREATORS

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting moral assessments of prominent political figures using a two-stage prompting strategy, and mapping the evaluated figures to ideological tags derived from the Manifesto Project's coding scheme to quantify the models' ideological stances.

Comparing the ideological responses of various LLMs when prompted across six official UN languages, and analyzing the variation in moral assessments based on the geopolitical region of the models' creators.
